newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO CATTLE REPORT, FEEDER EXPORT PRICE - USDA.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO CATTLE REPORT, FEEDER EXPORT PRICE - USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Thursday that around 1,900 head were exported into the United States at one crossing point Wednesday.
Through Presidio, Texas, around 1,900 steers were sold at prices 4-5 cents/lb lower compared to two weeks ago. "Trade moderate, demand good," USDA said.
Prices for head weighing 300-400 lb were 96-106 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head at 86-96 cents/lb. For head in the 500-600 lb range prices were 81-86 cents/lb, USDA said.
